name: milo-and-the-red-ball-read-along
transcript: Milo and the Red Balls. A story to read together. Open your book to page 3. Listen and look at the pictures. Page 3. A sunny day. Milo has a Red Ball. Hello Pip. Let's play. Turn the page. Page 4. Oh no. Milo kicks the ball. The ball rolls away. Oh no, where's my ball? Turn the page. Page 5 under the tree. Milo and Pip look. Is it under the tree? Pip finds a red leaf. No, it is a leaf. Turn the page. Page 6 in the box. Next they see a box. Is it in the box? Pip looks in the box. No, it is a hat. Turn the page. Page 7 behind the bench. Pip sees something red. Look behind the bench. Milo looks behind the bench. My Red Ball. Turn the page. Page 8, friends help friends. Milo smiles. Thank you Pip. You're welcome. Milo and Pip play together. Let's play. At the end.

name: milo-and-the-red-ball-listen-and-repeat
transcript: Milo and the Red Ball. Listen and repeat. Look at page 9. Listen, point, and say each word. Ball. Your turn. Ball. A tree. Your turn. A tree. A leaf. Your turn. A leaf. Box. Your turn. Box. Hat. Your turn. Hat. Bench. Your turn. Bench. Now look at page 10. Listen and say the phrases. Under the tree. Your turn. Under the tree. In the box. Your turn. In the box. Behind the bench. Your turn. Behind the bench. Now let us talk like Milo and Pip. Where is my ball? Your turn. Where is my ball? Let's play. Your turn. Let's play. Thank you Pip. Your turn. Thank you Pip. Your welcome. Your turn. Your welcome. Well done. You can read and speak English with Milo and Pip.
